parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing trans-specific restriction is documented: no border, document, facility, custody or emergency-care rule appears, and no trans-specific criminal offence exists. Visitor exposure therefore rests on social climate and thin recourse. Documented hostility is mainly framing: the Catholic majority regards transgender identity as immoral, and visibility is minimal. Discrimination is described as rare, though sources conflict on whether SOGI discrimination is banned. Hate-speech and hate-crime protections cover sexual orientation only, and I credit the 2010 enforcement only as sexual-orientation protection. No trans-specific violence figures exist, so the violence axis is undocumented, not safe. Sexuality statutes are secondary and largely unenforced. Lack of legal gender recognition is resident-facing and not deducted absent documented visitor effects. The dossier is thin, so I extrapolate toward a moderately reduced band, with the gender-identity recourse gap and moral framing pulling it below the 0.65 anchors.
